Osteophytes are bony projections that form along the edges of bones, often as a result of degenerative changes in the spine. Disc space narrowing refers to the reduction in the space between the vertebrae, which can be caused by various factors such as aging, injury, or disease. Endplate sclerosis is a thickening or hardening of the bone at the endplates, which are the surfaces of the vertebrae that come into contact with the intervertebral discs. These changes can be indicative of degenerative changes in the spine.
